spell.kubejs.to_the_lost.guide: One of the Grand Spells, under certain condition, you can cast the spell to travel between the World of Memories and the Reality.
spell.kubejs.earth_without_earth.guide: One of the Grand Spells, can only be casted using the Command Block Spell Book. Upon casting, it will generate a random  ore vein in the current chunk for Drilling Machine extraction. Note that the vein will only become permanent after being mined; otherwise, it will disappear upon leaving the world.
spell.kubejs.endless_dream.guide: When having the Sweet Dreams effect, casting the spell will increase the effect level by 1 and slightly extends its duration.
spell.kubejs.dream_of_needles.guide: When having the Sweet Dreams effect, casting the spell will decrase the effect level by 1 and generate needles that strikes nearby enermy. The number of the needles scale with the effect level of Sweet Dreams and the scroll level, while the damage scale with the remaining duration of Sweet Dreams.
spell.kubejs.dream_of_singing.guide: When having the Sweet Dreams effect, casting the spell will remove the Sweet Dreams effect and enhancing your base stats for a short duration. The level of the Sweet Dream effect determines the base damage bonus, while its remaining duration determines how long the boost lasts (max 60s). The scroll level determines the damage boost multiplier.
